svg.text: Ch 11 · Design a News Feed System
Publishing a post (orange, fan-out on write) and reading the feed (indigo)

g.text: Post is saved in the DB and post cache
Fanout service fetches the author's friends
Friend list + post ID go onto a queue for workers
Workers push the post ID into every friend's feed cache
Feed service reads the list of post IDs from cache
…then hydrates them with post content and author info
A fully built feed is returned as JSON
